title: Scaling enterprise security standards across the Marketplace
summary: See how Atlassian Marketplace strengthens enterprise security through continuous testing, incident response, and Atlassian Enterprise Certified.
body_markdown:
## A note from our CISO


Our largest enterprise customers run their most critical workflows on Atlassian cloud products. For many of them, that work relies heavily on apps built by our Marketplace partners to customize and extend Jira, Confluence, and the rest of our platform.


As security leaders, we know that every integration also introduces third-party risk. Evaluating that risk has traditionally been a painful, manual exercise. Security and procurement teams spend weeks sending 200-question questionnaires and reviewing annual audit reports. This approach creates friction, slows down the business, and only reflects a vendor’s security posture at a single point in time.


We believe securing an ecosystem requires continuous verification, monitoring and transparent trust signals to identify apps investing in security. Over the past year, we have expanded our marketplace security programs to pair foundational bug bounty coverage with managed annual penetration testing, joint incident response, and rigorous requirements across reliability, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI use.


Here is how these programs work together to protect your organization.


## Continuous crowdsourced testing via Marketplace Bug Bounty


Vulnerabilities do not adhere to an annual calendar. Continuous visibility requires continuous testing.


Running in partnership with our Marketplace partner community and Bugcrowd, the Marketplace Security Bug Bounty Program incentivizes an elite global pool of ethical hackers to continuously probe cloud apps for vulnerabilities. By leveraging crowdsourced security around the clock, this program helps partners discover and remediate potential risks.


While the legacy Cloud Fortified program is officially being sunset on Dec 31, 2026, the Marketplace Security Bug Bounty Program remains a foundational pillar of our ecosystem trust strategy. It continues as an independent, prominent Trust Signal filter in Marketplace search, spotlighting partners who invest in round-the-clock, crowdsourced defense.


Learn More:[Marketplace Security Bug Bounty Program](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/marketplace-security-bug-bounty-program/)


## Centrally managed, standardized penetration testing


At Marketplace scale, relying on individual partners to independently source and manage third-party penetration testers leads to inconsistent methodologies, varied reporting standards, and lower overall security assurance for buyers.


To establish a uniform standard of trust, we launched a centrally managed **Marketplace Penetration Testing Program** in January 2026. Under this program, partners enroll in annual assessments conducted by a dedicated pool of ***CREST-accredited*** security researchers who specialize in Atlassian Marketplace apps, selected directly from the top performers in our Marketplace Bug Bounty program. More than 100 apps have already been tested this year.


> In collaboration with Atlassian’s security team, Bugcrowd established a unified annual penetration testing program for assessments of Atlassian Marketplace partners. The program standardizes testing workflows across third-party marketplace applications for deep vulnerability discovery and to ultimately provide a degree of pre-onboarding and ongoing trust to Atlassian’s security team”
>
>
> Nicholas McKenzie, CIO & CISO, Bugcrowd


Atlassian oversees how each test is scoped, run and reported, so results are consistent and focused on the app itself. Partners can also use their own CREST-accredited testing provider, and those results are reviewed against the same standards. Each completed test gives partners a recognized security report they can share with customers. All PenTest findings are tracked, and partners must remediate them within the[Security Bug Fix Policy](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/security-bugfix-policy/) timelines.


> The new managed offering of the Marketplace Penetration Testing Program was a natural fit for us. It integrated seamlessly with our existing Bugcrowd-based security workflows, removed the need to source and manage a third-party vendor, and enabled meaningful cost savings compared to similar market offerings, while maintaining the depth and quality of the testing. It aligned exactly with what we were looking for.”
>
>
> Nicolas Esteves, Elements Apps


Customers can easily identify apps with verified, completed penetration tests by filtering for the Penetration Testing Trust Signal directly within Marketplace search.


Learn more:[Marketplace Penetration Testing Program](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/marketplace-penetration-testing-program/)


## Incident response collaboration with partners


Continuous testing and annual assessments are vital, but enterprise security doesn’t stop at prevention. When a potential incident emerges, clear communication and access to relevant information help partners respond effectively.


Through the Partner Security Incident Response Program, Atlassian’s global security team collaborates directly with Platinum partners and eligible Atlassian Enterprise Certified apps,[a new Marketplace trust program](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/search?trustSignals=atlassianEnterpriseCertified) , to support partner-led incident response. Partners remain responsible for investigating, responding to, and resolving security incidents involving their apps; however, Atlassian’s collaboration gives them access to additional platform context and communication channels to support that work:


- **Unified investigation:** If an issue arises, either side can trigger a joint incident room urgently with dedicated live channels, coordinated investigation workflows, and secure file sharing.
- **Platform-level visibility via Forge:** For apps built on Forge, Atlassian leverages platform-level runtime logs and telemetry while partners supply deep domain expertise on app behavior. Combining these insights can help improve root cause analysis and incident resolution.
- **Proactive operational readiness:** Atlassian routinely conducts live tabletop exercises and joint simulation drills with partners to ensure operational muscle memory long before an incident ever occurs.


For customers, this means app providers can draw on Atlassian’s platform expertise while retaining clear responsibility for the security and incident response of their apps.


Learn more:[Partner Security Incident Response Program](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/marketplace/partner-security-incident-response-program/)


## Bringing it all together: introducing Atlassian Enterprise Certified (AEC)


While each of these security programs represents a major leap forward, enterprise security and procurement teams shouldn’t have to piece together fragmented signals across separate documentation pages and lengthy vendor questionnaires.


That is why we are thrilled to announce the launch of **Atlassian Enterprise Certified (AEC)** badge, which highlights Marketplace apps that meet common enterprise needs for compliance, security, reliability, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI use.


AEC officially succeeds the Cloud Fortified program, elevating the bar for Marketplace trust. By establishing a single, credible mark of trust, the program helps organizations:


- **Accelerate procurement and review cycles:** Simplify procurement through verified requirements for compliance, security, reliability, privacy, accessibility, and responsible AI use.
- **Mitigate third-party risk:** Deploy apps backed by mandatory annual penetration testing, Bug Bounty, and coordinated incident response.
- **Validate security and compliance:** Independently verified SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001 certification.


Learn more:[What is the Atlassian Enterprise Certified program? | Atlassian Support](https://support.atlassian.com/organization-administration/docs/what-is-the-atlassian-enterprise-certified-program/)


## Deploy with confidence today


Securing your digital workplace is a shared commitment. We are dedicated to providing the transparency, verified standards, and enterprise resilience your organization needs to innovate safely across Atlassian Cloud.


Here’s how you can streamline your app evaluations right now:


- **Spot verified apps instantly:** Look for the Atlassian Enterprise Certified badge directly on app listing pages to identify solutions that meet our comprehensive enterprise benchmark.
- **Filter by your security requirements:** Use Marketplace search filters to zero in on the exact signals your risk and compliance teams require, including AEC, Bug Bounty, and verified Penetration Testing


[Visit the Marketplace today](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/)
